title: Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.01453v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. translated_title: 将过时表示重新用于部署后适应
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络越来越多地被部署在长期运行的系统中，在这些系统中，任务需求可能在训练完成后发生变化。在这种场景下，原始输出空间的一部分可能会变得过时：某个类别、预测区域或习得的行为可能不再有效。现有方法要么让过时行为保持不变，要么需要进行微调，而微调的成本可能很高。我们提出了深度重构，这是一个用于在任务过时情况下对模型进行适应的事后框架。DR 估计过时区域与保留区域的潜在几何结构，移除支持过时行为的组件，并通过一个解析修复映射在不进行任何梯度更新的情况下重新分配与保留任务兼容的证据。这使得修复后的预测和表示中，过时区域不再作为有效输出，而有用的过时结构反而可以支持保留的任务。在多个任务设置中，DR 能够在移除过时行为的同时保留原有任务的效用。
tldr: 提出了一种无需梯度更新的事后适应框架“深度重构”（DR），通过估计过时与保留区域的潜在几何结构并利用解析修复映射重新分配证据，使部署后模型中过时的输出行为失效，同时将有用的过时结构重新利用以支持保留任务。
en_tdlr: Proposes Deep Repurposing (DR), a gradient-free post-hoc adaptation framework that disables obsolete output behaviors in deployed models by estimating latent geometry and reallocating evidence via an analytic repair map, while repurposing useful obsolete structure to support retained tasks.
